$comment: R33 遥测 schema（551 号；543 号施工图 §4）——第 31 守门域，双端共享单一事实源。span 名 inkos.ai.request：语义重合键镜像上游 pi.ai.request（@earendil-works/pi-agent-core AI_TELEMETRY_SCHEMA 0.87 实测），域扩展键用 inkos.*（RunLogEntry 403 号九字段映射，model/durationMs/ok 由 span 属性与 status/时长天然承载不入属性）。格式与上游 TelemetrySchemaDefinition 一致。Rust serde 侧只投影不引运行时；改动本表须双端考古后显式更新并同步 core telemetry 模块断言。

inkos.ai.request.description: One governed LLM request on the InkOS provider boundary

pi.ai.streaming.description: Whether this operation returns a stream

inkos.agent.description: InkOS agent name or call label (RunLogEntry.agent)

inkos.attempt_index.description: Chain index of this attempt, 0 = primary (RunLogEntry.attemptIndex)

inkos.took_over.description: Non-primary attempt took over on first-round hit (RunLogEntry.tookOver, R25)

inkos.error_kind.description: InkOS error classification of a failed attempt (RunLogEntry.errorKind); absent on success

status.errorWhen: The request throws or reports a non-ok outcome
